forecast.label: 官方预告窗口
forecast.basis: Tibo 官方预告：主帖 Day 18「that's a reset!」（2026-10-23 12:46）+ 回复「Landing tomorrow before 10am PST together with a small ship.」（2026-10-23 12:47）。发帖时刻约为 PDT 10-22 晚 / 北京 10-23 中午，故 Pacific「tomorrow」= 10-23 PDT 上午；before 10:00 PDT（UTC−7）= 2026-10-23 17:00Z = 北京时间 2026-10-24 01:00 前。字面按 PST（UTC−8）则晚 1 小时至 02:00。「small ship」指同日小产品发布，不是 credits/banked 额度包。最近已完成全局重置仍为 Day17（2026-10-23 01:00，#57；用户 10-23 03:05 确认，Tibo 尚无 Done 帖）。这是预告，不是已落地确认；完成次数仍为 57。
forecast.change: 出现 Done / “propagated” / Radar 实测落地 / 用户额度确认 → 记为已完成 #58 并退出预告态；窗口（01:00 BJ，或字面 PST 02:00）过后仍无落地证据 → 报「预告窗口已过，落地未核实」，不顺延。
forecast.hour_note: 官方时点：北京时间 2026-10-24 01:00 前（PDT）；备选字面 PST：02:00 前。

forecast_check.actual_basis: Tibo 官宣帖时间（Radar 已收录该帖，但无实测落地时间）
forecast_check.verdict: 未命中：实际重置早于窗口开始约 26 分钟（窗口从 PT Day16 起算，但 Day15 在 PT 当晚 23:33 就重置了）
forecast_check.lesson: Day 15 原判为「功能发布日」，但 Tibo 在 PT 当日结束前改成了重置；挑战期内同一天可以从 ship 改判为 reset，窗口应覆盖当前 PT 日的剩余时段。

estimate_superseded.verdict: 已被 Day18 官方预告取代（估计窗口起点前出现官方「before 10am PST」+ small ship）

prior_hit.verdict: 命中：Day17 于 2026-10-23 01:00 BJ 前落地，位于该估计窗口内（期间被官方预告取代）

banked.summary: The banked reset Tibo announced landed on our monitoring accounts.
40M active users milestone: one banked reset loaded into every paid Codex and ChatGPT Work account on Day 3 of the 28-day series, alongside GPT-6 in Chat.
A new banked Codex reset landed on our monitoring accounts. Tibo has not announced it on X yet.
GPT-6 Sol and Luna launch: one banked reset loaded into every Plus, Pro and Business account, alongside a permanent 50% API price cut.
Some banked resets did not fully apply in ChatGPT Work and Codex that morning; everyone who used one in the affected window gets another one plus an apology email.
Astra rolled out ahead of schedule, and every Plus, Pro and Business user still gets a full banked reset that day, landing by end of day.
Astra access compensation, second day: a banked reset for the Plus and Business users still without Astra, landing by end of day.
Astra access compensation: one banked reset for every day without Astra on a paid ChatGPT plan, starting that day — the first drop promised about three hours later.
The 20M-milestone banked reset landed in accounts for all paid Codex and ChatGPT Work users, redeemable on demand.
Banked reset delivery window: arriving by 8pm PST for all paid ChatGPT Work and Codex users.
20M active users milestone: announced one banked reset for every Codex and ChatGPT Work user, credited during the day for on-demand use.
7M active users milestone: added a banked reset to every account, appliable on demand from desktop/web.
Added a banked reset to 500k ChatGPT Work/Codex users; shipped banked-reset redemption on web and mobile.
